gloss: piggy bank; coin bank; money box

definitions.gloss: piggy bank; coin bank; money box
definitions.explanation: A container, often shaped like an animal, used for saving coins. A familiar household item, especially for children learning to save money.

examples.japanese: {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put money in the piggy bank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ブタ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The child has a pig-shaped piggy bank.

examples.japanese: {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}ったら→割る：02334_waru⟧、{三万円|さんまんえん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: When I broke open the piggy bank, there was 30,000 yen inside.

notes:
USAGE:
A common everyday word. Traditional Japanese {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ} come in various shapes; some are designed to be broken open (⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧) when full.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put money in a piggy bank)
- {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ (to break open a piggy bank)
- {貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (for a piggy bank to become full)

FORMS:
⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧ (savings) + ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ (box). The ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ becomes ば due to rendaku.
